title.es: Aquel en el que Santiago ata a Fina
title.en: The One Where Santiago Ties Fina Up

description.es: Marta va a la habitación de Fina. Le dice que al editor le han gustado mucho las fotos que hizo Fina. Le dice que es muy buena fotógrafa y que cree que tendrá mucho éxito en este campo. Fina responde que, si se dedica a la fotografía profesional, tendrá que dejar su puesto de dependienta, y que eso hará que se aleje de Marta. Marta dice que le dolería más que Fina no aprovechara las oportunidades que se le presentan, y que debería elegir lo mejor para su carrera. Quedan en verse en Mafinca esa noche. Fina va a Mafinca y se encuentra cara a cara con Santiago. Santiago ata a Fina y espera a Marta.
description.en: Marta comes to Fina's room. She tells her that the publisher liked the photos Fina took very much. She says that she is a very good photographer and that she thinks Fina will be very successful in this field. Fina replies that if she takes up professional photography, she will have to leave her shop assistant job, and that this will cause her to be apart from Marta. Marta says that it would hurt her more if Fina did not make the most of the opportunities that come her way, and that she should choose what is best for her career. They arrange to meet at Mafinca that evening. Fina goes to Mafinca and comes face to face with Santiago. Santiago ties Fina up and waits for Marta.
